digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared none is neutral and contributes no paths, unlike undeclared children which poison sibling inheritance
Scope precedence resolves any own/cited/inherited dependency path to paths; explicit parent none to none; all-live-children-none to none only when all are authenticated none; otherwise unscoped
Cheap resign in resign.py must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
P9 passes declared-none leaves and containers with all-live-children-declared, advises only live undeclared children, and names both path declaration and --none as remedies
Mixed-scope signatures (paths + none children) must sign only path-child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift but become stale on declared child path changes
No live children must not synthesize all-none scope, and any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance preserving conservative unscoped fallback
